headline: Allentown superintendent gets new 3-year deal with performance bonuses
summary: Allentown School District Superintendent Maria Gonzalez will stay on under a new three-year contract approved Tuesday night. The board voted 7-2 in favor. Board member Williams dissented, calling the 3 percent raise excessive.

headline: Easton Farmers Market kicks off summer season with 50 vendors and live music
summary: The Easton Farmers Market returns to Centre Square this Saturday with over 50 vendors, the most in the market's history. New additions include a live music stage and a children's cooking demo area.

headline: PennDOT to close Route 22 eastbound lanes for repaving starting tonight
summary: PennDOT will close the right two lanes of Route 22 eastbound between the Route 33 interchange and 25th Street in Easton starting at 9 p.m. tonight. Work will continue nightly through Friday. Expect significant delays during the overnight hours.
